entries.title: fix(channels): return complete member rosters
entries.rationale: Accepted as security-sensitive membership and discovery hardening, queued because full-roster authorization effects, transactional mention indexing, and the targeted admin republish path require Zion relay and rollout review.
security_reasons: complete membership roster feeds NIP-29 discovery and admin-role authorization
large roster mention indexing must remain transactional and bounded
targeted reconciliation replaces authoritative relay-signed snapshots
relay private-key handling and production rollout command require operator review

tracking.implementation_plan: Implement only after dedicated membership/authorization threat review, migration and operator-command review, large-roster tests, dependency/egress screening, Zion compatibility checks, and relay gates.

verification: Full-SHA diff, database/relay/admin changes, ignored large-roster tests, dependency impact, and compatibility surfaces reviewed; no source implementation made.
